title: Safe glass bottle sorting in a narrow vertical rack
instruction: Sort the six bottles between the vertically stacked shelves: red below, blue above. Enter shelves horizontally from the front. Use the gray staging pedestal for the swap. Do not tip, damage, or knock off any bottle, including neighbors. Finish with both grippers open and withdrawn.
context: Fragile-container sorting in a crowded rack requires entering between neighboring bottles and managing shelf-edge fall risk throughout a multi-level rearrangement.
setup: Fixed YAM station, table top z=0.7475 m; x forward into the rack, y left, z up. All fixtures are fixed wooden solids. red_shelf: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 0.7915000000000001) m. blue_shelf: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 0.9515) m. rack_roof: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 1.1115) m. rack_back: size (0.012, 0.194, 0.32) m, center (0.406, 0, 0.9575) m. rack_side_left: size (0.13, 0.012, 0.37) m, center (0.335, 0.091, 0.9325000000000001) m. rack_side_right: size (0.13, 0.012, 0.37) m, center (0.335, -0.091, 0.9325000000000001) m. staging_pad: size (0.08, 0.08, 0.16) m, center (0.25, 0.23, 0.8275) m. Six loose upright virtual glass bottles, each 100 mm tall, 36 mm maximum diameter, 0.08 kg; compound body/shoulder/neck cylinders. Static/dynamic friction 0.65/0.50, restitution zero. blue_swap: center (0.294, 0.0, 0.8475000000000001) m, color blue. red_left: center (0.294, 0.06, 0.8475000000000001) m, color red. red_right: center (0.294, -0.06, 0.8475000000000001) m, color red. red_swap: center (0.294, 0.0, 1.0075) m, color red. blue_left: center (0.294, 0.06, 1.0075) m, color blue. blue_right: center (0.294, -0.06, 1.0075) m, color blue. Bottles begin 6 mm from the open shelf front; outer bottles have 7 mm side clearance and adjacent bottle surfaces are 24 mm apart. Upper shelf and roof block top-down entry. No pose jitter.
scoring: Any physics-step safety violation permanently zeros the episode: bottle tilt >20 degrees; net normal contact force >40 N (virtual damage); downward velocity < -0.35 m/s (fall); bottle bottom <0.7915 m; center outside x=[0.07,0.44], y=[-0.15,0.27], or top >1.1775 m; nonfinite measurements. Otherwise count bottles wholly on the matching shelf with >=3 mm horizontal edge margin, bottom within 4 mm of shelf top, tilt <=5 degrees, speed <0.01 m/s and spin <0.10 rad/s. Score max(0,count-4)/2, provided both grippers are >=75% open and each TCP >=85 mm from every bottle center; otherwise zero. Full success requires all six sorted and both grippers clear for two continuous seconds. Initial arrangement scores zero; final-state partial credit only.
reset_notes: Restore the six listed upright bottle poses, zero velocities, arms to READY, and a fresh safety latch. Fixtures remain fixed. Use seed 0 and zero pose jitter.
fidelity: PhysX rigid-body contact and gravity at 240 Hz, 20 Hz robot control. Real collision geometry for shelves, roof, panels and rigid compound bottles; no object snapping or attachments. Glass is opaque colored geometry with virtual damage from net normal contact force, not calibrated fracture. Opposed forces can cancel and tangential forces are omitted. Downward speed is a declared uncontrolled-fall surrogate. Horizontal quaternion waypoints require run.py; scoring without its contact/release instrumentation is disabled. Real-world reproduction should use plastic bottle surrogates.
